messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
அப்போது பயம் சிறிது அமைதியாகியது, என் இதயத்தின் ஏரியில் அது நீடித்தது நான் மிகவும் இரக்கத்துடன் கடந்து சென்ற இரவு.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Allor | “then, at that moment” | **அப்போது** | then | OK | | fu | copular auxiliary “was” (pluperfect) | — (implicit in “அமைதியாகியது”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | la (1) | definite article (fem. sing.) | — (articles omitted in Tamil) | — | UNNECESSARY | | paura | noun “fear” | **பயம்** | fear | OK | | un | indefinite article “a” | — (articles omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | poco | adverb of degree “a little” | **சிறிது** | a little | OK | | queta | adjective/past‑participle “quieted” | **அமைதியாகியது** | quieted / became quiet | OK | | , | comma (source punctuation) | **,** | , | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which/that” | — (clause integrated without explicit pronoun) | — | UNNECESSARY | | nel | preposition “in the” | **இல்** | in | OK | | lago | noun “lake” | **ஏரி** | lake | OK | | del | preposition “of the” (genitive) | **இன்** | of | OK | | cor | noun “heart” (poetic *cor*) | **இதயம்** | heart | OK | | m'era | clitic + auxiliary “had (to me) been” | — (experiencer not expressed) | — | UNNECESSARY | | durata | verb “lasted” (pluperfect) | **நீடித்தது** | lasted | OK | | la (2) | definite article (fem. sing.) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | notte | noun “night” | **இரவு** | night | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun “that” (with elision) | — (integrated) | — | UNNECESSARY | | i' | pronoun “I” | **நான்** | I | OK | | passai | verb “passed” (remote past) | **கடந்து சென்ற** | passed / went through | OK | | con | preposition “with” | **உடன்** | with | OK | | tanta | adjective “so much” | **மிகவும்** | so | OK | | pieta | noun “pity” | **இரக்கம்** | pity | OK | | . | period (source punctuation) | **.** | . | OK |
---
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: fu, la (1), un, che, m'era, la (2), ch'i' (These elements are required in Italian but are naturally omitted or absorbed in Tamil.)
- **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 19: - Original: அப்போது பயம் சிறிது அமைதியாகியது, - Issue: none - Corrected: அப்போது பயம் சிறிது அமைதியாகியது, - Line 20: - Original: என் இதயத்தின் ஏரியில் அது நீடித்தது - Issue: none - Corrected: என் இதயத்தின் ஏரியில் அது நீடித்தது - Line 21: - Original: நான் மிகவும் இரக்கத்துடன் கடந்து சென்ற இரவு. - Issue: none - Corrected: நான் மிகவும் இரக்கத்துடன் கடந்து சென்ற இரவு.
